per_step.command:
# Create output directory if it doesn't exist
mkdir -p /app/output

# Process each patient individually and collect results
> /app/output/resource_allocations.json

echo "[" > /app/output/resource_allocations.json

# Process patient P1001
severity_p1001=$(/usr/local/bin/assess_urgency.sh P1001)
echo "Processing P1001 - Severity: $severity_p1001"
/usr/local/bin/assign_resources.sh P1001 $severity_p1001 >> /app/output/resource_allocations.json
echo "," >> /app/output/resource_allocations.json

# Process patient P1002
severity_p1002=$(/usr/local/bin/assess_urgency.sh P1002)
echo "Processing P1002 - Severity: $severity_p1002"
/usr/local/bin/assign_resources.sh P1002 $severity_p1002 >> /app/output/resource_allocations.json
echo "," >> /app/output/resource_allocations.json

# Process patient P1003
severity_p1003=$(/usr/local/bin/assess_urgency.sh P1003)
echo "Processing P1003 - Severity: $severity_p1003"
/usr/local/bin/assign_resources.sh P1003 $severity_p1003 >> /app/output/resource_allocations.json
echo "," >> /app/output/resource_allocations.json

# Process patient P1004
severity_p1004=$(/usr/local/bin/assess_urgency.sh P1004)
echo "Processing P1004 - Severity: $severity_p1004"
/usr/local/bin/assign_resources.sh P1004 $severity_p1004 >> /app/output/resource_allocations.json
echo "," >> /app/output/resource_allocations.json

# Process patient P1005
severity_p1005=$(/usr/local/bin/assess_urgency.sh P1005)
echo "Processing P1005 - Severity: $severity_p1005"
/usr/local/bin/assign_resources.sh P1005 $severity_p1005 >> /app/output/resource_allocations.json

echo "]" >> /app/output/resource_allocations.json

# Clean up the JSON format (remove trailing comma before closing bracket)
sed -i '$s/,$//' /app/output/resource_allocations.json

echo "All patients processed. Checking results..."

# Calculate average wait time and resource utilization
cat /app/output/resource_allocations.json | jq -r '.[].wait_time_minutes' | awk '{sum+=$1; count++} END {print "Average wait time: " sum/count " minutes"}'

cat /app/output/resource_allocations.json | jq -r '.[].resource_utilization' | awk '{sum+=$1; count++} END {print "Average resource utilization: " sum/count " %"}'
